propositions: Ticket directory creation happens outside the write lock in _prepare_event, leaving a window where makedirs succeeds but the first event file is not yet written, causing interrupted writes to strand empty ticket dirs that fsck flags as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH

New staging module publishes ticket directory and its first event file atomically via os.rename, eliminating the makedirs-then-die window by building both in a temporary staging path before publishing

Staging directories use dot-prefixed naming convention (.tmp-newticket-*) making them invisible to existing fsck scanners without scanner changes, while actual ticket directories are published complete or not at all
The atomic publish occurs under the existing write lock so events remain invisible until rebase guard and under_lock_check pass, preserving lock discipline and concurrency guarantees
Stale staging directories from dead processes are cleaned up on writer startup using pid-namespace and process-start-time stamps to avoid pid recycling confusion
